lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity circular blobs are organized into approximately six distinct vertical columns posterior to the gill slits, creating a regular 2D grid arrangement across the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity align with and intersect the high-luminance blobs, forming a series of grid-like anchor nodes across the lateral surface.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent longitudinal ridge runs horizontally across the upper third of the visible flank, defined by a sharp vertical intensity gradient with light-colored pixels on the dorsal edge and a shadowed region below.

other_distinctive_markers: Multiple commensal fish (remoras) are visible in the water column immediately below the pectoral fin and ventral-lateral flank.
